item-handbooktext-creature-seaserpent2: The common serpent of deep saltwater. It stalks swimmers and boats in water at least 50 blocks deep, circles for a while, then strikes at anyone in the water. It will not bite a player sitting in a boat. It retreats once you reach water less than 3 blocks deep and gives up about 30 seconds after you leave the water. When killed it sinks to the sea floor. Dive down and harvest the corpse with a knife (hold shift and right click anywhere on its body) for fish, bone, rusty gears and Jonas parts. See the Underwater Horrors guide.
item-handbooktext-creature-seaserpent: The rarer, aggressive surface serpent (about one spawn in ten). It hunts near the surface rather than in the deep and flees less readily when hurt. Same weaknesses as the sea serpent: shallow water and dry land. Its harvest includes rust loot. See the Underwater Horrors guide.
item-handbooktext-creature-giantserpent: A rust serpent grown five times over, some 220 blocks from jaw to tail, and rare: it comes only out in the open ocean, about one serpent in twenty there. It never surfaces to hiss. It circles deep below its prey, then rises mouth first out of the dark. Boats are no shelter from it: it swallows a raft in one gulp, breaks a sailboat in a few bites and leaves the crew in the water. It strikes only over deep water, so the shallows and dry land are still safe. It can be wounded only while its body passes the surface after a strike. Badly hurt, it flees for a minute, then comes back and fights to the death. Killed, it breaks apart into its glowing segments, which sink to the sea floor; each holds a share of its hoard of rusty gears, temporal gears and Jonas parts, with fish and bone. Right click a segment with a knife to cut it open and spill its share into the water. None comes again for two hours after one is killed. Patches of cold blue light grow over its hide like coral on a wreck, and light up the water around it. See the Underwater Horrors guide.
item-handbooktext-creature-krakenbody: A very rare deep water horror. The body rests on the sea floor and sends tentacles up toward a swimmer. A tentacle that reaches you grabs and drags you down; killing one of the claws around you breaks the grip. Tentacles stall and give up when you climb into a boat or onto land. See the Underwater Horrors guide.
game:uh-guide-text:
Underwater Horrors
Horrors dwell in the depths.

Lore
During the time of the Rot, many traders fled land for life on the seas. They did not live there long, however, before the corruption of the ocean became apparent. All that remains of them now are sunken shipwrecks, skeletons, and perhaps the occasional remnant of their technology from within the belly of a horror.

Where they live
Serpents and the kraken spawn only in saltwater at least 50 blocks deep, near a player who is swimming or sailing in it. Rivers, ponds and shallow coasts are safe. Only one creature is normally alive in the world at a time.

Sea Serpent
The sea serpent circles a swimmer, then strikes. It will not attack a player sitting in a boat. To escape, reach water shallower than 3 blocks or get onto land; it retreats and despawns about 30 seconds later. The rust serpent is the rarer, more aggressive surface hunter.

Rust Leviathan
Out in the open ocean, the serpent that comes is sometimes a rust leviathan, a rust serpent five times the size, its hide spotted with cold blue light. It never surfaces to hiss. It circles deep below, a dark shape under the water, then rises mouth first from the dark. Boats are no shelter from it: a raft goes down in one gulp, a sailboat in a few bites, and the crew lands in the water. Make for the shallows, or fight: strike its body as it arches through the waves after a strike. At a quarter of its health it draws off for a minute, then returns for the kill. Killed, it breaks apart, and every segment sinks with its share of rusty gears, temporal gears, Jonas parts, fish and bone. Right click a segment with a knife to cut it open: its loot spills into the water, the fish and bone floating up and the metal sinking. None comes again for two hours.

Kraken
The kraken is very rare and more likely at night. Its tentacles reach up from the deep and drag a swimmer down. Kill one of the claws around you to break the grip. Tentacles cannot follow you into a boat or onto land.

Loot
A killed serpent sinks to the sea floor. Dive down and harvest it with a knife, holding shift and right click on any part of its body, then take what it holds; bring breath to spare.

Temporal storms
Stay off the sea when a temporal storm comes. While it rages, something finds you in moments, in water only 15 blocks deep, and every serpent is a fast rust serpent. Up to five hunt at once, tentacles lash three times as fast, and the leviathan is far more likely.

Ruins
Sunken ruins, wrecks and a drowned city generate on the deep sea floor. Glowing ghostlights mark them from a distance. They hold collapsed chests and piles of ingots, and most are guarded: a spawner block wakes a serpent (rarely a kraken) when you swim close. Spawner blocks cannot be mined.

Staying safe
Shallow water, land and boats, though a boat will not stop the leviathan. Creative and spectator players are ignored.

For server owners
Everything above is configurable in ModConfig/UnderwaterHorrorsConfig.json: spawn depth and chance, how many creatures may live at once, kraken chance, ruin rarity and loot, sound volumes, and freshwater spawning. The metals and sizes of ingot piles in ruins nobody has visited yet follow the current config. Admin commands live under /uh (spawn, ruins, ghostlights, observer, debug, sound, giantcooldown, stormfrenzy) and /uhruin.
blockhelp-serpentspawner: Spawns a sea serpent when a player enters the water nearby, then vanishes until that serpent despawns.
blockhelp-krakenspawner: Spawns a kraken when a player enters the water nearby, then vanishes until that kraken despawns.
item-handbooktext-creature-giantanglerfi: A colossal angler, a hundred blocks long, that lies on the sea floor off coasts at night like a carpet shark among the rocks. A pole rises from its head with a glowing temporal gear at the tip, and it casts the gear out on a long line to hang over the waves, luring sailors and swimmers toward land. Follow the light too close to its mouth and it rises from the deep and swallows you in one gulp. Its gear has 10 health: the first blow knocks a temporal gear loose at your feet and the fish flees; break the gear and another falls, and the fish races off. Swim over its back and it rises and strikes from below. It hunts from the shore too: stand by deep coastal water at night and one may come to lie off the beach. Killed, it sinks to the floor and can be harvested with a knife. It sinks back into the deep at daybreak. Admins can summon it with /uh spawn anglerfish, or off the nearest coast with /uh spawn anglerfish coast.
